headline: Trace+ 1.0.0 — find what your project no longer needs.
_comment: THE UPDATE FEED FOR TRACE+. Commit to the ROOT of nkcourses/traceplus-updates as updates.json.
SEPARATE REPO FROM TRACE, ON PURPOSE. Both help pages render their own repo's GitHub Releases
as the changelog, so one shared repo would interleave Trace and Trace+ releases on both
DO NOT COMMIT THIS UNTIL TRACE+ ACTUALLY SHIPS. A feed announcing 1.0.0 when there is nothing
to download is worse than no feed - the panel will offer an update that does not exist.
Same three fields and the same four rules as Trace's feed; see trace-updates.json.
One extra thing to remember for a PAID product: a version bump here reaches people who have
not paid for the new build only if the licence covers it. The licence does not expire, so it
does - but if that ever changes, this feed is where the mistake becomes visible.
